scope: Independent read-only source review; not a claim of authentic closed-loop AGC landing or external live model success

findings.item: Original test-final target omitted crew_ai.py provider tests; root reports replacing it with complete backend discovery.

verified_source_properties: Scientific artifact seals are checked before launch and authentic recordings are derived from retained execution traces.
Educational physical controls remain a separate explicitly labeled mode without authentic AGC navigation claims.
All human, fallback and model command proposals use the same role, run ID, sequence and finite actuator validation path.
Server-side provider adapter limits tool scopes by the three historical crew roles and omits credentials and native paths from supplied telemetry.
Model requests run asynchronously from fixed-step physics; provider failure falls back to labeled deterministic policies.
Original bounded attitude endpoints remain inherited rather than being replaced.
limits: This review does not verify an external live model provider; protocol and failure cases require separate tests.
Local shared browser clients are supported; this service binds only to loopback.
Original full-sprint authentic AGC-guided landing is still unavailable, and the independent educational landing mode must retain that distinction.
